reference: Chromium 141.0.7390.37, V8 14.1.146.11 (see the header of tools/golden/math.mjs for how each value is obtained)
encoding: columns: base64 of little-endian arrays: f64 = IEEE-754 binary64 bit patterns (NaN canonical 0x7ff8000000000000), i32/u32 = 32-bit integers

atan2.note: Math.atan2(a, b): a is y, b is x

imul.note: Math.imul(a, b); the inputs are integers of any size a double holds

clamp.note: the game's clamp(v, lo, hi) with (v, lo, hi) = (c0, c1, c2)

pow.note: Math.pow(a, b) restricted to arguments whose result is fixed by IEEE 754 or the ECMAScript special cases

named: round(-0.3) keeps the sign of zero
clamp(12, 10, 3) is 10 (lo wins when lo > hi; Godot clampf gives 3)
mod(-7.5, 2) takes the sign of the dividend
atan2(-143.99999999997817, 107.99999999995634): the last bit differs in libm (Godot builtin ...335, V8 ...334)
exp(-0.55 * (1 / 60)): a damping factor of the enemy steering
imul(4294967295, 2): the arguments are converted with ToInt32 first
pow(1, Infinity) is NaN in JavaScript (C pow gives 1)
